collection_attempt_notes: Final successful static collection is the timed 40-Git-command inventory. Earlier preparatory collector attempts stopped on report-status capitalization and a multiline TOML source-line locator; no product command ran and no evidence file was emitted by those failed attempts. They are not product failures or additional accepted runs.

document_checks.note: These 20 final verification Git commands and preparatory probes are separate from the timed 40-command successful source collection. No product gate was run.
document_checks.peer_read_only_review: PASS; no must-fix. Clarified that owner rules are already specified in the contemporaneous main proposal, with implementation acceptance pending.

method: Verify all five val.md SHAs, public origins and clean tracked/untracked state before and after.
Read immutable Git trees/blobs with Git only; parse TOML, requirements, Python imports and configuration statically. Never execute upstream setup.py or import ReproLLM.
Independently select the first 500 lexicographic tracked Python files and parse absolute imports; confirm the selected boundary against reviewed historical facts.
Derive warnings from supported source declarations/imports and the normative repository aggregation contract, then compare with val.md and historical reviewed reference.
Keep unsupported setuptools/build/dependency-group evidence separate; no new parser, lock claim or gold is authorized.
open_decisions: Owner pairing/barrier rules are now specified in main proposal section 2.1; positive/negative implementation fixtures are pending. This real portfolio has no format lock and cannot establish those cases.
setup.cfg/computed setup.py/dependency-groups scanning or self-package exclusion needs a separate approved parser/scope contract and independently reviewed expectations.
Exact declaration coverage, requirements-closure membership and selected-experiment environment completeness remain distinct; no schema1 selected_experiment field is invented.
Main proposal preserves complete outputs as the acceptance target. Any added external provenance presentation requires a prior precise amendment, independent expectations and fresh final Gate A.
